description: Why venture capital and private equity are separate categories, what 'accredited investor' means and the risks behind that requirement (illiquidity, failure rates, manager dependency), and what a family office is, including 2026 cost and AUM-threshold figures for single-family and multi-family offices. Full content with an active plugin subscription; otherwise lesson titles and key takeaways only.
